scope: Entire one-project catalogue index reconciled against one legacy biblical dataset, not all known OT manuscripts

catalogue.attribution: Qumran-Digital, DFG project 465277421, with predecessor Qumran-Wörterbuch
catalogue.content_consulted: index labels, CSS class, link identifier and listed version only; no bulk transcriptions or images
catalogue.rights_note: Only factual catalogue metadata exported; no source transcription, apparatus or image is vendored or relicensed.

qdr.attribution: Qumran Digital Reader, Michael Muzar; upstream ETCBC/Naaijer and Abegg transcriptions
qdr.content_exported: label-level discovery metadata only; no text or full verse index

classification_documentation.meaning: Italic biblical classification is pragmatic; default transcription is current version.

policy.candidate_rule: casefold and remove whitespace/periods only; no prefix/suffix deletion, fuzzy matching or numeric reassignment
policy.next_gate: Resolve identity and genre against institutional catalogues/editions before passage-level preserved-text comparison.
